Test build for Windows. Download **Glyphling-Setup-0.4.0.exe** below and run it: it installs Glyphling, or updates an existing install in place without uninstalling (settings, themes and position are kept).

### New
- Custom installer, updater and uninstaller with its own dot-matrix interface.
- Glass with the desktop blurred behind it, on the widget, the tray menu and Settings; the window is clipped to the widget's real shape.
- The panel layout mirrors when it opens to the left.
- The mouse wheel works on every dial interaction.
- Settings redesigned with a sidebar, more opaque glass and more responsive buttons; frameless title bar with minimise and close.
- Snapping uses the centre of the circle when closed and the centre of circle plus panel when open.
- With a fixed panel side, the widget moves just enough for the panel to fit on screen.
- Tray menu without the mode list; level buttons centred.
- Better contrast for secondary text.

### Notes
- The setup is not signed yet: if SmartScreen warns, choose "More info" → "Run anyway".
- CPU temperature needs LibreHardwareMonitor running with its web server enabled.
